title: When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?
abstract: arXiv:2611.05877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $\Delta^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. translated_title: 何时更好的置信度才能改善知识图谱审计？
translated_abstract: 置信度估计在由大语言模型构建的知识图谱中指导人工审核，但更好的错误预测在审计中可能只带来微小的改进。我们通过可修复性、选择余量和标签有效性来研究这一差距。将非自适应审计建模为预算约束下的覆盖问题，我们刻画了最小化的决策相关错误统计量，并用结构质量 $\Delta^{\mathrm{cl}}$ 界定了保持标量的一阶规划的遗憾。我们在 Re-DocRED 上针对五个抽取配置和两个跨文档图谱，基于与基准对齐的标签模拟理想修复，随后在测试集上进行冻结确认，并在 500 个哈希选取的训练文档上进行复现实验。在留出的跨文档图谱上，错误率×扇出队列在相同动作下比联合模型多留下 3.98–4.74 个百分点的错误。相比之下，为该联合规划器开放共享动作可将残余错误减少 0.89–1.43 个百分点。
tldr: 该论文通过将非自适应审计建模为预算化覆盖问题，从理论上刻画了更好的置信度何时才能真正提升知识图谱审计效果，并通过结构质量 $\Delta^{\mathrm{cl}}$ 界定规划遗憾，实验证明联合模型规划器比错误率×扇出队列少留下 3.98–4.74 个百分点的错误。
en_tdlr: This paper models non-adaptive knowledge-graph auditing as budgeted covering to theoretically characterize when better confidence estimates improve audits, bounding planner regret by structural mass $\Delta^{\mathrm{cl}}$, and shows empirically on Re-DocRED that a joint-model planner leaves 3.98–4.74 percentage points fewer errors than an error-rate × fan-out queue.
